remarks:
Located on South Portage Street in the Village of Westfield, this well-maintained, move-in-ready home offers ample living space and several recent updates. A covered front porch leads to a large entry foyer, with French doors opening to the living room and fireplace. The kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry and counter space, along with a large dining area and access to the backyard and deck. A first-floor bedroom and half bath complete the main level.

Upstairs, three bedrooms, an additional room that could serve as a fifth bedroom, office, or den, a full bathroom, and second-floor laundry. Nearly all the windows have been replaced, along with numerous other improvements throughout the home.

The detached two-car garage offers plenty of space for vehicles, storage, or a workshop, plus a separate area currently used as a game room that could also serve as a home gym, hobby room, or additional workspace.

Just a short distance from downtown Westfield, with local shops, restaurants, the library, the school, and parks. Lake Erie and Barcelona Harbor are only a few miles away, offering beaches, boating, fishing, and more. A great location with the convenience of village living and easy access to everything the Westfield area has to offer.
